report:
Prepuce, circumcision

Received in formalin is a piece of foreskin, measuring 3 x 2 x 0.3 cm. Representative sections in 1 block.

(1) Foreskin, representative sections.

Sections of the prepuce show stratified squamous epithelium. The epithelium is atrophic, with hyperkeratosis and a band of homogenised, sclerotic collagen in the superficial dermis, beneath which there is a band-like lymphocytic infiltrate. Features are consistent with lichen sclerosus. There is no evidence of penile intraepithelial neoplasia or malignancy.

PREPUCE, circumcision - Consistent with LICHEN SCLEROSUS (balanitis xerotica obliterans)
